methodology.name: Website Accessibility Conformance Evaluation Methodology 2.0
steps: Define the scope of the evaluation

scope.target: HTML5Assay 0.1.0 candidate web and terminal interfaces
included: Bundled playground initial state and safe/unsafe specimen analysis flows
Keyboard-only traversal, visible focus, status communication, errors, and state recovery
Light, dark, forced-colors, reduced-motion, and 200 percent text presentations
Native dialog and popover flows exercised by the browser qualification page
CLI help, pretty result, error, and Inconclusive output read through an accessible terminal
excluded: Companion-assay interfaces, which are reviewed under RG-19
Generated consumer applications outside the included package and playground examples

minimumConfigurations.versions: record exact versions in the completed report
record exact versions in the completed report

requiredReportFields: evaluation scope, goal, conformance target, and baseline
evaluator identities, roles, expertise, dates, and any conflicts
exact candidate commit, archive filename, and archive SHA-256
explored views, functionality, technologies, and accessibility features
structured sample, any random sample, and selection rationale
exact operating system, browser, assistive technology, terminal, and versions
test procedure and result for every applicable WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA success criterion
keyboard, focus, zoom, reflow, forced-colors, reduced-motion, live-region, dialog, popover, and recovery observations
issue location, reproducible steps, impact, affected users, severity, and evidence
conformance finding, limitations, exceptions, and unresolved questions
reviewer decision, reviewer identity, and UTC completion timestamp
completionRule: RG-21 remains pending until qualified humans execute this plan against the bound candidate and an accessibility lead accepts the completed report.
invalidationRule: Invalidate the completed review if the candidate Git commit or archive SHA-256 changes, or if an evidence-only change alters this plan or the reviewed report.
